abstract: Best practices for @hellajs/ui, the copy/paste component registry CLI: the init/add/list workflow, hella.ui.json precedence, css vs tailwind style splicing, the split theme artifacts (tokens.ts / theme.css) and dark-default mode, peer installs, --lang js delivery, and the ownership contract - no runtime import surface; the copy is your code. Every rule is grounded in the package source and test suite.
